jobs.title: ABOUT US
jobs.description: SCIPLAY’S STORY A spark of ingenuity in 1999 ignited SciPlay’s rise to become a social gaming powerhouse today. Our secret weapon? Best-in-class talent. Passion ignites us, teamwork unites us, and winning defines us. Our teams have created industry-leading solutions like our proprietary AdTech, engaging LiveOps, and a cutting-edge data engine. As Light & Wonder’s social gaming division, we combine our expertise with its industry-renowned strengths to cultivate world-class, player-first experiences. jobs.title: LIFE AT SCIPLAY
jobs.description: CULTURE EATS STRATEGY FOR BREAKFAST At SciPlay, culture isn’t just a buzzword. It’s about breaking molds and gathering a squad of diverse, insanely talented individuals. Culture is our secret sauce that flavors our games, defines our workplace, and fuels our vision for the future. Pull up a chair and savor it with us. Join Us CORE VALUES INCLUSION FUELS INNOVATION Diverse perspectives drive our success. When people from all walks of life come to the table, a fire of innovation is ignited, and amazing things happen. We are committed to building a team where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Whether you’re a data guru with a global soul, or an artist who speaks in hues, we want you on our team. We believe that when we come together, we can unlock our collective superpower. Join us and let's play a game where everyone wins. Join Us SPARK CIRCLES Being a Player-First Focused Company starts with our SciPlayers! From cultural celebrations to advocating for change, our employee resource groups create a space for connection, community and fun!
